trang_phuc.liubei_t5a: Liu Bei at age 35, a tall slender man in his mid-thirties, calm gentle face, unusually long arms that hang down to his knees, unusually large earlobes, a thin moustache and a short sparse beard of fine hair along the jaw and chin (visibly bearded but much lighter and shorter than a full beard), hair in a topknot under a black official cap, wearing a long dark-indigo cross-collared official robe with a dark sash and a leather belt, plain dark shoes, a restrained dignified look, no embroidery
trang_phuc.liubei_t5b: Liu Bei at age 35, a tall slender man in his mid-thirties, calm gentle face, unusually long arms that hang down to his knees, unusually large earlobes, a thin moustache and a short sparse beard of fine hair along the jaw and chin (visibly bearded but much lighter and shorter than a full beard), hair in a topknot, no official cap, a plain pale cloth headband, wearing a creased and dusty dark-indigo cross-collared robe with a loosened dark sash and a leather belt, worn plain shoes, tired but composed, no insignia

trang_phuc.lubo_t5b: Lu Bu, a tall powerfully built man with a strong jaw and sharp eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain iron helmet, wearing well-kept iron scale armour over a dark-red cross-collared robe with a dark-red cloak, the confident bearing of a man newly given a province
trang_phuc.lubo_t5c: Lu Bu, a tall powerfully built man with a strong jaw and sharp eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain cloth band, wearing dented dusty scale armour and a frayed dark-red cloak, weary and travel-stained after defeat, no insignia
trang_phuc.lubo_t5d: Lu Bu, a tall powerfully built man with a strong jaw and sharp eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain iron helmet, wearing cleaned iron scale armour over a dark-red cross-collared robe with a dark-red cloak and a leather belt with a small official fitting, the confident bearing of a man who has taken a province
